- non-link dry-run output unchanged (ppg:17 etcd baseline diff empty)

**Verify:** venv/bin/black percona_obs/ && venv/bin/pyright

**Steps:** capture baseline dry-run; add helper; switch expanded arg; black+pyright+diff; commit -s. Full code in plan Task 1.
